newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds finish week off on steady note.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds finish week off on steady note.

text.p: 1420 GMT - Austrian bonds end out the week on a friendly note with activity kept at a low ebb due to the public holiday in the U.S., traders said.
Market focus at home is on the new bond issue on Tuesday, which market participants say is likely to carry a 30-year maturity.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 up 25 bps at 99.85 to yield 5.64 (5.68) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.80/90 to yield 5.65/64 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 up 10 bps at 100.15 to yield 4.59 (4.61) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.06/16 to yield 4.61/58 percent.
* Austrian bond future up seven bps at 109.68 on turnover of 74 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany down one at five bps, five-year spread steady at 19 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.393 and overnight money at 3.13/3.38. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 256
